ja: 映像が10分ずっと固まってますよ。
en: Your video's been freezing for ten minutes.
alternatives: Your video's been frozen for ten minutes.
Your video has been stuck for ten minutes.
point: 続いている状態は has been freezing と現在完了進行形

ja: 田中さん、ミュートです。
en: Mr. Tanaka, you're on mute.
alternatives: Mr. Tanaka, you're muted.
Mr. Tanaka, your mic is muted.
point: ミュート中は you're on mute が定番の言い方

ja: 途切れてたのは、回線じゃなくてそちらの音声ですよ。
en: It was your audio, not the line, that cut out.
alternatives: What cut out was your audio, not the line.
It was your audio that cut out, not the line.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that で挟む

ja: 会議のリンクはどこですか？
en: Where is the meeting link?
alternatives: Where can I find the link?
Where's the link for the meeting?
point: Where の後は is the link の語順にする

ja: 私の画面、みなさん見えますか？
en: Can everyone see my screen?
alternatives: Is my screen visible to everyone?
Can you all see my screen?
point: 「見えますか」は can see で表す。are seeing としない

ja: 会議室からかけているので、声が反響するかも。
en: Calling from a meeting room, my voice may echo.
alternatives: I'm in a meeting room, so my voice may echo.
Since I'm calling from a meeting room, it may echo.
point: 同じ主語の理由は -ing で始める分詞構文にできる

ja: 請求を担当している方に、つないでいただけますか？
en: Could you put me through to whoever handles billing?
alternatives: Could you connect me with the person who handles billing?
Would you put me through to whoever's in charge of billing?
point: 「担当の方」は whoever handles と現在形で言える

ja: 彼、マイク確認しとけばよかったって言ってたよ。
en: He said he wished he'd checked his mic.
alternatives: He said he should've checked his mic.
He told me he wished he'd checked his mic.
point: 過去への後悔は wish + had 過去分詞

ja: 上司に確認してから、折り返しお電話します。
en: After checking with my boss, I'll call you back.
alternatives: I'll check with my boss and call you back.
Once I've checked with my boss, I'll call back.
point: 「〜してから」は After＋-ing でも言える

ja: 二回途切れたので、いったん切ってかけ直します。
en: Having lost you twice, I'll hang up and redial.
alternatives: After losing you twice, I'll hang up and call back.
We got cut off twice, so I'll call you back.
point: 理由は Having＋過去分詞で前に置ける

ja: 彼が忙しくても、折り返し電話をくれるよう伝えてもらえますか？
en: Even if he's swamped, could you have him ring me back?
alternatives: Even if he's busy, could you get him to call me back?
Busy or not, could you have him call me back?
point: 「〜させる」は have him + 原形。ring me back は電話の定番

ja: 今電話中の人は、部長のアシスタントです。
en: The person on the phone is the manager's assistant.
alternatives: The person talking on the phone is the manager's assistant.
The person who's on the phone is the manager's assistant.
point: 「電話中の人」は the person on the phone と後ろから直す

ja: すみません、今のが聞き取れませんでした。
en: Sorry, I didn't catch what you said.
alternatives: Sorry, I couldn't catch what you said.
Sorry, I missed what you just said.
point: 「今のが」は what you said で表す

ja: 先ほど送ったリンクから会議に入ってください。
en: Please join the meeting using the link sent earlier.
alternatives: Please join through the link I sent you earlier.
Please use the link I sent earlier to join.
point: 「送ったリンク」は the link sent earlier と後ろから修飾

ja: 向こうはノートPCのマイクを使ってたのかもね。
en: They might have been using a laptop mic.
alternatives: They may have been talking into a laptop mic.
Maybe they were using a laptop mic.
point: 過去の推量は might / may have + 過去分詞

ja: 回線が不安定でも、このまま続けていい？
en: Even if the line's shaky, can we keep going?
alternatives: Can we keep going even if the line is shaky?
Although the line is shaky, can we keep going?
point: 「〜でも」は Even if。keep のあとは -ing

ja: ゆっくり話してもらえますか？
en: Could you speak more slowly?
alternatives: Could you talk more slowly?
Can you speak a bit slower?
point: slow ではなく副詞 slowly を more で比べる

ja: 接続テストしてれば、時間を無駄にしなかったのに。
en: If we'd tested the connection, we wouldn't have wasted time.
alternatives: We wouldn't have wasted time if we'd tested the connection.
Had we tested the connection, we wouldn't have wasted time.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、帰結は wouldn't have 過去分詞

ja: 音声は大丈夫だけど、そちらの映像は固まってるよ。
en: Your audio's fine, whereas your video is frozen.
alternatives: Although your audio's fine, your video is frozen.
I can hear you fine, but your video's frozen.
point: 対比は whereas か although でつなぐ

ja: 担当者は手が離せなくて、あと10分かかります。
en: Our rep is tied up for another ten minutes.
alternatives: Our rep is busy for another ten minutes.
Our rep won't be free for another ten minutes.
point: 「手が離せない」は tied up が定番

ja: あの電話、回す前に内線を確認すべきだった。
en: I should've checked the extension before transferring that call.
alternatives: I should've confirmed the extension before putting it through.
I should've double-checked the extension before I transferred it.
point: 過去の後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 今運転中なので、後でかけ直します。
en: I'm driving. I'll call you back.
alternatives: I'm driving now. I'll call you later.
I'm driving right now. I'll call back.
point: 今している最中のことは I'm driving と進行形で言う

ja: この回線、少し雑音がありますね。
en: There's some noise on this line.
alternatives: There's a little noise on this line.
There is some noise on the line.
point: 「雑音がある」は There's some noise で、noise は数えない

ja: 電話を切って初めて、ミュートだったと気づいたよ。
en: Only after hanging up did I realize I'd been muted.
alternatives: Not until I hung up did I realize I was muted.
I didn't realize I'd been muted until I hung up.
point: Only after 〜 の後は疑問文の語順（did I realize）

ja: 声は聞こえますが、映像は固まっています。
en: I can hear you, although your video is frozen.
alternatives: Even though I can hear you, your video is frozen.
Your video is frozen, although I can hear you fine.
point: 対比は although で。but と二重にしない

ja: その電話はもう営業部に回されました。
en: That call has already been transferred to Sales.
alternatives: That call was already put through to Sales.
That call's already been sent to Sales.
point: 「回された」は has been transferred と受動態で

ja: 私が共有している画面、見えますか？
en: Can you see the screen I'm sharing?
alternatives: Do you see the screen I'm sharing?
Can you see the screen I'm showing?
point: the screen のあとに I'm sharing を続けて説明

ja: カメラ、オフにしてもいいですか？
en: Can I turn my camera off?
alternatives: May I turn off my camera?
Could I turn my camera off?
point: 許可を求めるのは Can I 〜? で、Can you と取り違えない

ja: 音声が途切れてたけど、あれからヘッドセット替えた？
en: Your audio kept cutting out. Have you swapped headsets since?
alternatives: Your audio kept dropping out. Have you changed headsets since?
Your audio kept breaking up. Have you switched headsets since?
point: 過去の出来事は過去形、あれからの変化は現在完了

ja: さっき電話してきた人、誰でしたっけ？
en: Who was the man who just called?
alternatives: Who was that person who called earlier?
Who was the one who just called?
point: 「電話してきた人」は who called で人を後ろから説明

ja: 私は、こんなに途切れる通話を経験したことがない。
en: Never have I had a call this choppy.
alternatives: I've never had a call this choppy.
Never have I been on such a choppy call.
point: Never を文頭に出すと、have I の語順に倒置する

ja: 山田さんが君にも入ってほしいって。
en: Yamada wants you to join too.
alternatives: Yamada would like you to join too.
Yamada wants you to join us too.
point: want you to join の形。want that you と言わない

ja: 声が遠いよ。マイクに近づいたほうがいい。
en: You should get closer to your mic.
alternatives: You should move closer to your mic.
You'd better move closer to the mic.
point: 助言は should、「近づく」は get closer to

ja: 転送を押したら、お客様はもう切っていました。
en: When I pressed transfer, the customer had hung up.
alternatives: The customer had already hung up when I transferred.
The customer had hung up before I pressed transfer.
point: 先に起きた「切った」は had hung up、過去分詞は hung

ja: 私の声が切れたら教えてください。
en: If my voice cuts out, please tell me.
alternatives: Please tell me if my voice cuts out.
Let me know if my voice cuts out.
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形 cuts out にする

ja: 回線が不安定だから、かけ直したほうがいいですね。
en: The line's unstable, so we should call back.
alternatives: Since the line's unstable, we should call back.
The connection's unstable, so we'd better call back.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should か had better で言う
